readerCopy.body: A message becomes more powerful because nobody can agree on exactly what it promises. A speech, post, artistic statement, or private assurance leaves enough room for each listener to hear the future they want. Mercury gives the vision words and circulation, while Neptune softens the edges that would make the meaning testable. Under the conjunction, communication and projection become part of the same message. The ambiguity may attract a wide audience while setting up disappointment when people discover they agreed to different versions.
